title: [Bug] Most build-in Slash Commands Not Working in VS Code Extension 2.0.x
body: **Bug Description** After updating to Claude Code extension 2.0.x (now on 2.0.5 ) in VS Code, most built-in slash commands no longer work. For example, when I type /help or /rewind in the Claude input box, I only see “no matching commands”. No dropdown or command execution happens. in the vs code claude terminal i do get those commands there they work fine only in extension they dont appear. Environment: VS Code: latest stable release (e.g. 1.104.2) Claude Code Extension: 2.0.5 OS: Windows 11 Steps to Reproduce: Install Claude Code extension v2.0.5. Open the Claude chat panel in VS Code. Type /help or /rewind. Result: “no matching commands” instead of showing the built-in command list. Expected Behavior: Typing /help should show the available built-in commands. Typing /rewind should rewind the conversation. Troubleshooting Tried: Verified VS Code is on the newest version. Uninstalled/reinstalled VS Code with cleanup Uninstalled/reinstalled Claude Code extension. Current Result: Slash commands like /help and /rewind don’t work, always showing “no matching commands”. Request: Could you confirm if this is a known bug in 2.0.5? And is there a workaround or upcoming fix so that built-in slash commands become available again? **Environment Info** - Platform: win32 - Terminal: vscode - Version: 2.0.5 - Feedback ID: 44e3ac39-f887-4595-80c7-c5b9a4332713 **Errors** ```json [] ``` see here a small batch of available commands.
